blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu—About eight out of every 10 people in jail were involved in illegal drugs, and a Lapu-Lapu City police official cited that fact in calling for stronger coordination among government and communities. “Kasagaran sa mga nakakulong sa atung prisuhan, almost 80% ay directly related sa illegal drugs. (Almost 80 percent of those in prison have cases directly related to illegal drugs.) This includes pushing, possession, and use of illegal substances,” said City Director Col. Agosto Daskeo. He underscored the link between illegal drugs and crime in a program for Drug Abuse Prevention and Control Week 2026. Lapu-Lapu City has […]...
